name: vibegui

alignment.label: Alignment
alignment.question: Does what I am doing serve the future I declared?
alignment.measure: Share of active work traceable to a declared outcome.

integrity.label: Integrity
integrity.question: Is it whole and complete?
integrity.measure: Count of word items currently unacknowledged. Target zero — integrity is a mountain with no top, so this is never a percentage.

domains.word: What I said, what I know to do, what is expected of me, what I assert is true, what I stand for, and the standards I operate under. Kept, or honored when it cannot be kept.
domains.systems: Design, implementation, and use integrity. Secrets stay server-side, permissions are real, the reviewer is not the author.
domains.objects: Every claim has an artifact that opens. A green check nobody can open is a rumor.

conditionsOfSatisfaction: Private and public are separate by construction.
Personal data stays under personal control.
Spread curiosity is visible; execution is concentrated.
The experience is elegant and inviting.

strategicResults.title: My projects move as one portfolio
strategicResults.narrative: Every active personal project is visible in one map, connected to an explicit outcome and the evidence of whether it is moving. The gap between the declaration and the measurement is the work.
acceptanceCriteria: Every active project has a goal, success criteria, state, and next review
A useful daily brief is reviewed at least five times per week
The system surfaces stale commitments and recommends concrete next steps

strategicResults.title: Prior art is available before a branch exists
strategicResults.narrative: What already exists — inside my own writing and outside it — is searchable at the moment an idea is shaped, so I stop rediscovering things I already said.
acceptanceCriteria: The corpus answers "have I already written this" in one query
Bookmarks are enriched and searchable, not a dead list
A shaped proposal cites its prior art

strategicResults.title: Ideas can die before they cost a week
strategicResults.narrative: Between an idea and a branch there is work that is not code: the smallest test that could embarrass the idea. This stage prevents shipping the wrong thing faster.
acceptanceCriteria: Work carries acceptance criteria written before the branch exists
At least one idea dies in this stage on purpose
Validation names who it was tested with

strategicResults.title: The factory is a connection, not a rebuild
strategicResults.narrative: Execution belongs to a factory, never to this system: Worldview declares, measures, and scores, and never writes code, opens a pull request, or ships. Which factory is an open bet — deco Studio and Runtime are parallel attempts at the same function and one of them wins. What the outcome requires is the same either way: a queue derived from the gap rather than typed into a box.
acceptanceCriteria: A work queue populates from the gap without anyone typing a task
Every work item names the declared outcome it serves and the measurement that exposed it
No work item completes without an artifact that opens
The Studio-versus-Runtime bet is decided on evidence rather than left running indefinitely

metrics.label: Queue items derived from the gap

strategicResults.title: Important distinctions can be gotten through conversation
strategicResults.narrative: A navigable graph of distinctions across leadership, integrity, future-based language, software, AI, Brazil, and the other subjects I stand for — each with a clear essay, its sources, and a path that creates the possibility of a genuine change in perspective.
acceptanceCriteria: Twelve distinctions have an essay, graph position, sources, and guided path
Readers complete real guided conversations
Repeatable paths that help people get a distinction are identified

strategicResults.title: My library and conversations make each other better
strategicResults.narrative: Books and source materials are mapped to concepts and distinctions. Conversations reveal where an idea remains unclear and what deserves development, and those signals enter a review pipeline that never turns model output into truth by default.
acceptanceCriteria: Twenty books or primary sources are mapped
Conversation signals enter a private review pipeline
No model output becomes public truth without review

strategicResults.title: Conversations become artifacts worth sharing
strategicResults.narrative: When a reader gets something important, it can become a beautiful, consented, cited artifact that brings another person into the conversation without exposing private detail.
acceptanceCriteria: A conversation can produce a redacted and consented artifact
Every artifact cites its sources and map location
Organic sharing happens repeatedly and establishes a baseline

strategicResults.title: Anyone can keep their declared future in git
strategicResults.narrative: The copyable thing is not a template of my tooling — it is the declaration itself. A person can fork this, write their own future, connect it to the factory they already use, and begin without becoming an infrastructure expert.
acceptanceCriteria: A new person reaches a useful first gap report from the documentation alone
Ten independent declarations are running
Three independent maintainers contribute

strategicResults.title: Important connections do not disappear
strategicResults.narrative: A trustworthy map of the people who matter across the different chapters of my life, grounded in evidence from sources I control — because the people around you shape the future you are able to declare.
acceptanceCriteria: The first trusted circle is mapped with provenance
Identity merges and relationship claims are reviewable
The system can explain why a person may help and where I can help first

strategicResults.title: My word exists when it comes time to keep it
strategicResults.narrative: The failure this system exists to defeat: not having your word exist at the moment it comes due. Commitments are tracked, and honoring one I cannot keep — acknowledge, say what happens instead and by when, clean up — is a first-class move rather than an apology.
acceptanceCriteria: Every commitment has an owner and a by-when
A commitment that will not be kept can be honored in one step
The system can show, unprompted, a promise it did not keep

strategicResults.title: My personal files form a usable library
strategicResults.narrative: Integrity of objects: files across Mac, iCloud, and Drive searchable as one private map, with a canonical copy that is knowable and reversible operations only.
acceptanceCriteria: Mac, iCloud, and Google Drive are indexed
Canonical and duplicate candidates are visible
Every move or archive operation has a dry run, audit trail, and recovery path
